title: Computer Basics
description: Build confidence with computers before jumping into code.
first_task: Create a folder called My Learning and organise five files inside it.

title: Python Foundations
description: Learn programming fundamentals through small, practical Python exercises.
first_task: Write a Python program that asks for your name and prints a welcome message.

title: Web Development
description: Go from a blank file to a responsive personal webpage.
steps: CSS layout, spacing, and responsive design
Build and publish a small website
first_task: Create a one-page profile using only HTML.

title: Git, GitHub & Open Source
description: Learn how to save, share, document, and collaborate on code.
steps: Issues, contribution guidelines, and pull requests
first_task: Create a public repository with a README describing what you are learning.

title: Linux & Terminal
description: Become comfortable navigating and working in a Linux environment.
steps: pwd, ls, cd, mkdir, cp, mv, and rm
Text files, editors, and command history
Simple shell scripts and safe workflows
first_task: Create a directory tree for your learning projects using terminal commands.

title: AI & Machine Learning
description: Understand the foundations of data, models, evaluation, and responsible experimentation.
steps: Complete and document a small ML experiment
first_task: Load a small dataset, inspect its columns, and write three observations.

title: Cloud & DevOps
audience: Beginner with basic Linux and Git
description: Explore how applications are packaged, tested, deployed, and monitored.
steps: Deploy a small application and document it
first_task: Create a README diagram showing how code moves from a commit to deployment.

title: Research Fundamentals
description: Learn to ask focused questions, read papers, run reproducible experiments, and report evidence.
steps: Define a research question and baseline
Track datasets, methods, and experiment settings
Write limitations, results, and references honestly
first_task: Read one paper and write its problem, method, result, and limitation in four bullets.
